label: Appetitive principle following intellect: AppetitivePowerOf p x: p is an appetitive principle of x
term: appetitive principle following intellect (AppetitivePowerOf p x, FollowsIntellect p)
definition: AppetitivePowerOf p x: p is an appetitive principle of x (a power in creatures; in God no really distinct power is asserted, DISAMB-CREATURE-PASSIVE-APPETITE-AND-DIVINE-WILL). FollowsIntellect p: p follows intellectual, not sensitive, apprehension (q.80 a.2). The pair is the intellectual species of DEF-COGNITION-RELATIVE-APPETITE; the open premise STMT-INTELLECTUAL-APPETITE-IS-WILL identifies it with will (DEF-HAS-WILL). In Lean parameters P -> B -> Prop and P -> Prop.
note: Stipulative analyst notion, attribution deferred (round 5 worklist, specs/round5-worklist.toml). Sourcing it would need a typed reading of the cited articles; until then it is constrained only by the open premises that use it.
